# Version 4.152.4 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m152 cache correction**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.4 updates Skia to correct failed-flush cache handling. The bundled renderer adopts the current upstream m152 maintenance fix for cache state after an unsuccessful GPU flush.

*None in this preview line.*
